title: Orders within date range
statement_markdown: Write a query to find information based on orders(id, customer_id, amount, order_date).
hints: Review the problem statement and expected output.
reference_solution: SELECT id, amount FROM orders WHERE order_date BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-03-31' ORDER BY order_date
